messages.author: 398c6dffb6726242
messages.subject: MaxQuant 2.0.2 ans MSstatsTMT
parts:
Dear MSstats team,

I used MSstatsTMT to process data from TMT10 runs searched with MaxQuant v2.0.2. The processing went through (with some notes or warnings that might relate to this special data set. I checked the output table from the protein comparison step and realized that MSstats TMT generated for some entries additional protein groups. That mean that there is only one row in the MaxQuant proteinGroups.txt file for a certain protein group but there are two rows containing the same protein in an other protein group (either a single protein ID or another group of protein IDs with a different number of entries) that is not present in the MaxQuant proteinGroups.txt file. Can you please explain what is wrong.

I also noticed that in this version of MaxQuant the column headers might have changed. There are no more columns named "Leading.proteins" or Leading.razor.proteins" in the prouteinCroups.txt file but besides the "Protein.IDs" there is now a "Majority.protein.IDs" column. It might be worth to adapt the MaxQtoMSstatsTMTFormat converter to cover this change in the "which.protein" argument.

Best K_H.
